integrity: The general statement is proved analytically from the face KKT equations, the simplex vertex oracle, and a one-variable quadratic line search. Exact-rational computation independently replays a representative chain and a finite family of one-step identities; finite enumeration is explicitly not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes a positive diagonal quadratic aligned with the simplex coordinates, exact line search, and a vertex linear-minimization oracle.
The stated finite-termination path starts from a face minimizer; arbitrary interior or mixed face starts are not classified.
No floating-point finite-termination claim is made.
title: Line-search Frank–Wolfe becomes fully corrective on diagonal simplex quadratics
